errors.evidence: The description incorrectly swaps the axes. The chart is a horizontal bar chart where the vertical axis lists the categories (factors) and the horizontal axis shows the percentages.
The bars are not arranged in random order; they are sorted in ascending order based on their percentage values, from top to bottom.

The highest bar (83.8%) corresponds to the category "Добре подготвен професионален екип с опит" (Well-prepared professional team with experience), not "Осигурено финансиране" (Secured financing), which has a value of 43.2%.
